verdict.rationale: Carta's own API docs confirm the core cap-table entities (issuers, share classes, stakeholders, option grants, convertible notes, SAFEs, 409A/FMV data) are all live, queryable objects in a single system, and describe partners, law firms, and auditors accessing this data programmatically — matching the 'single source of truth' story. Community evidence (billing/support complaints, PG's spam remark) is about sales practices and cancellation friction, not about the accuracy or reliability of the cap table data itself, so it doesn't contradict this axis. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on confirmation that investors and auditors actually rely on Carta as source of truth (only vendor docs), and no product UI evidence beyond API references.
